verdict.rationale: Slack's docs directly claim AI note-taking for huddles (key takeaways, action items, who said what compiled at huddle end) and AI-generated channel/thread summaries and daily recaps for content missed, matching the story's core ask. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of huddle-note accuracy or completeness, and no explicit confirmation that recaps cover 'missed' meetings specifically (recaps are framed around channels/threads more than scheduled meetings).
